exposure: Antenatal care (ANC) in the first trimester
Birth notification to health extension workers
Prenatal stay at maternity waiting homes
outcome: Utilization of maternal and newborn health care services across the antepartum, intrapartum, and postpartum continuum
cohort: Women who had live births in the 12 months preceding the survey in Amhara, Oromia, SNNP, and Tigray regions of Ethiopia
finding: Despite good access to antenatal care, only one-fifth of women in Ethiopia utilized the full continuum of maternal and newborn health care services, with significant disparities based on socioeconomic factors and program-related factors.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean section was found to be a predictor of continued use of maternal and newborn health care services at the postpartum stage.
